nodes.responsibility: Fix the high-concurrency race condition in FinancialLedger so that 50 concurrent requests with the same idempotency key result in exactly 1 transfer execution, with remaining requests returning the completed transaction.
invariants: Do not use Condvar inside Mutex to avoid Rust borrow checker errors (E0502 and E0499).
Use IdempotencyRecord with InProgress(Instant) and Completed(Transaction) in idempotency_store.

When a transfer arrives: check idempotency_store with write lock. If InProgress, wait/loop with brief sleep. If Completed(tx), return Ok(tx). If not present, insert InProgress(Instant::now()) and proceed.
Perform account balance deduction and deposit inside accounts write lock.
Update idempotency_store to IdempotencyRecord::Completed(tx) upon successful transfer.
Do not modify or delete existing methods in src/models.rs or src/audit.rs.
acceptance_tests: cargo test --test stress_test passes with 0 race condition failures under 50 concurrent threads.
